annotations.title: Audit Key Personnel LCAT Qualifications & Tailor Shipley Resume + LOC

description: Evaluate a candidate's resume against RFP Section L/M Key Personnel and GSA MAS / OASIS+ / Alliant 3 Labor Category (LCAT) requirements (years of experience, education, security clearance, DoD 8570/8140 certifications), rewrite relevant roles into a Shipley Key Personnel bio, and generate a ready-to-sign Letter of Commitment (LOC). This is a read-only, stateless qualification audit and resume formatter that does not store candidate PII (requires X-RapidAPI-Key; `allow_education_experience_substitution` [default true] applies standard federal GSA/OPM equivalency rules such as Bachelor's + 4 years = Master's when scoring eligibility). Use this tool when qualifying and formatting individual Key Personnel resumes for a proposal; use `match_capability_statement` instead to score overall company-level Bid/No-Bid Pwin, or `generate_cpars_past_performance` for company-level contract citations.

allow_education_experience_substitution.description: When true (default), applies standard federal GSA/OPM degree-for-experience substitution rules (e.g., Bachelor's + 4 additional years of specialized experience satisfies a Master's requirement) unless the RFP text explicitly prohibits substitutions.

candidate_resume_text.description: Candidate's unstructured resume or CV including education degrees, active security clearances, professional certifications (CISSP, PMP, AWS, etc.), and chronological work history.

lcat_or_rfp_requirements.description: Raw RFP Section L/M Key Personnel instructions, GSA MAS / GWAC Labor Category (LCAT) minimum qualifications, required security clearance, and mandatory DoD 8570/8140 certifications.

name: match_key_personnel

letter_of_commitment_loc.description: Ready-to-sign Key Personnel Letter of Commitment (LOC) template.

qualification_score.description: Candidate LCAT/Key Personnel compliance score from 0 to 100.

requirement_audit_matrix.description: Line-by-line audit of education, years of experience, clearance, and certification mandates.

tailored_shipley_resume_markdown.description: Rewritten Shipley Key Personnel biographical sketch and compliance-mapped experience bullets.
